mechanism.claim: An unusually active completed Korean cash session supplies independent spot participation to a high-variation BTC move. When Upbit KRW-BTC base turnover is in its causal upper tail, the completed Binance BTC direction should relay for twelve hours rather than represent derivatives-only noise.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed Binance BTCUSDT 00:00-08:00 UTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: KCLR compared unadjusted venue return magnitudes and required price-sign agreement; KPAR measured FX-adjusted kimchi-premium acceleration. KCVSR uses neither venue-price leadership nor kimchi premium: Upbit contributes only causally ranked base-volume participation while Binance supplies direction and realized variation.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: Binance session realized variation must rank at least 0.65 causally
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one regional cash-volume-conditioned 08:05 UTC clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.session: exact aligned bars_upbit KRW-BTC and bars_binance BTCUSDT 1m paths [00:00,08:00) UTC; all 480 timestamps required
features.upbit_base_volume: sum of 480 finite nonnegative KRW-BTC base-volume observations; strict positive
features.binance_realized_variation: sqrt(sum of squared log(1m close/open)) over all 480 Binance bars; strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 earlier source-valid daily sessions, minimum 180; current excluded
features.eligibility: Upbit base-volume rank>=0.75 and Binance realized-variation rank>=0.65
features.availability: 08:00 UTC after both exact source paths complete
features.missing_duplicate_nonfinite_or_nonpositi: ineligible or source failure; no imputation

clock.decision: each calendar day 08:00 UTC after both source sessions complete
clock.side: strict sign of completed Binance session return
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economic stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent Korean cash participation channel plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no session, source, rank, side, hold, timing, volatility, subset, threshold, or control repair.
